compiled_state.title: Refactor ci-llm-review-runner.sh to delegate all LLM calls through llm-api-call.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: ci-llm-review-runner.sh contains zero hardcoded model strings, zero direct curl to provider APIs, zero DSO_LLM_MODEL references
- DD2: all former curl sites delegate to llm-api-call.sh (light, deep ×3 specialists, deep arch, overlays ×3)
- DD3: runner is tier-aware — light/standard/deep paths each use per-tier config lookup via llm-api-call.sh

## Implementation Notes

All changed files: `plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh` only.

Delegate interface: `bash "$(command -v llm-api-call.sh)" <system-prompt-file> <user-message> <tier>`
- llm-api-call.sh is on PATH via `$_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts` (already appended at runner line ~25)
- Returns normalized LLM text on stdout (fences already stripped)
- Validates API keys internally — runner no longer needs to check ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

### Explicit removals (DD1)
- Lines 43-45: `[[ -z "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}" ]] && { ... exit 1 }`
- `_build_specialist_request()` function (~30 lines)
- Line 88: `MODEL="${DSO_LLM_MODEL:-claude-sonnet-4-6}"` (deep tier)
- Line 266: `MODEL="${DSO_LLM_MODEL:-claude-sonnet-4-6}"` (light/standard tier)
- All `python3 - <<'PYEOF'` request-building inline scripts (4 blocks)
- All `curl -sf ...` call blocks (6 occurrences at lines 126, 137, 148, 211, 293, 388)

### Light/standard tier replacement (DD2, DD3 — tier = $SELECTED_TIER)
Replace the entire curl + request-build + LLM_TEXT extraction block with:
```bash
LLM_TEXT=$(bash "$(command -v llm-api-call.sh)" "$AGENT_FILE" "Review this diff:\n\n$DIFF_CONTENT" "$SELECTED_TIER") || LLM_TEXT=""
FINDINGS_JSON=$(printf '%s' "${LLM_TEXT:-}" | python3 -c "
import json,sys; t=sys.stdin.read().strip()
if not t: raise ValueError('empty')
json.loads(t); print(t)
" 2>/dev/null) || {
  echo "WARNING: LLM response parsing failed. Writing inconclusive review." >&2
  FINDINGS_JSON='{"scores":{"hygiene":"N/A","design":"N/A","maintainability":"N/A","correctness":"N/A","verification":"N/A"},"findings":[],"summary":"Review inconclusive: LLM response could not be parsed as reviewer-findings JSON."}'
}
```
Note: no fence-stripping code needed — llm-api-call.sh already handles it.

### Deep tier specialist replacement (DD2, DD3 — tier = "deep")
Remove `_build_specialist_request()` calls; replace 3 parallel curl calls with:
```bash
bash "$(command -v llm-api-call.sh)" "$_PLUGIN_ROOT/agents/code-reviewer-deep-correctness.md" \
  "Review this diff:\n\n$DIFF_CONTENT" "deep" > "$_SLOT_CORRECTNESS" &
_SPECIALIST_PIDS+=($!)

bash "$(command -v llm-api-call.sh)" "$_PLUGIN_ROOT/agents/code-reviewer-deep-verification.md" \
  "Review this diff:\n\n$DIFF_CONTENT" "deep" > "$_SLOT_VERIFICATION" &
_SPECIALIST_PIDS+=($!)

bash "$(command -v llm-api-call.sh)" "$_PLUGIN_ROOT/agents/code-reviewer-deep-hygiene.md" \
  "Review this diff:\n\n$DIFF_CONTENT" "deep" > "$_SLOT_HYGIENE" &
_SPECIALIST_PIDS+=($!)

for _pid in "${_SPECIALIST_PIDS[@]}"; do wait "$_pid"; done
rm -f "${_SPECIALIST_REQ_TMPS[@]:-}"  # no-op (array may be empty)
```
PRESERVE fail-closed slot validation after `wait`: check each slot file exists and contains valid JSON before proceeding to arch synthesis (existing validation logic, lines ~160-169, UNCHANGED).

### Deep tier arch synthesis replacement (DD2, DD3 — tier = "deep")
Remove arch curl block; replace with:
```bash
_ARCH_RESP=$(bash "$(command -v llm-api-call.sh)" "$_PLUGIN_ROOT/agents/code-reviewer-deep-arch.md" \
  "$_ARCH_USER_MSG" "deep")
FINDINGS_JSON=$(printf '%s' "$_ARCH_RESP" | python3 -c "
import json,sys; t=sys.stdin.read().strip()
if not t: raise ValueError('empty')
json.loads(t); print(t)
" 2>/dev/null) || {
  echo "WARNING: Arch LLM response is not valid reviewer-findings JSON." >&2
  FINDINGS_JSON='{"scores":{"hygiene":"N/A","design":"N/A","maintainability":"N/A","correctness":"N/A","verification":"N/A"},"findings":[],"summary":"Review inconclusive: Arch response could not be parsed."}'
}
```
Note: `_ARCH_USER_MSG` construction (combining slot file contents + diff) is UNCHANGED.

### Overlay dispatch replacement (DD2, DD3 — tier = "deep")
Rename `_run_overlay_curl` → `_run_overlay_llm`. Replace entire curl-based body with:
```bash
_run_overlay_llm() {
  local _agent_file="$1" _slot_file="$2"
  bash "$(command -v llm-api-call.sh)" "$_agent_file" "Review this diff:\n\n$DIFF_CONTENT" "deep" > "$_slot_file" || true
}
```
Rationale for "deep" tier: overlay agents (security-red-team, security-blue-team, performance, test-quality) are opus-class per agent table; "deep" maps to `model.deep` config key (= opus).
Update all 3 call sites: `_run_overlay_curl` → `_run_overlay_llm` (no signature change, no other changes needed).
Serial blue-team dispatch: `_run_overlay_llm` (same rename only).

### Error guard behavior post-refactor (story consideration verification)
- Empty stdout from helper: `|| LLM_TEXT=""` → FINDINGS_JSON fallback = inconclusive (fail-open ✓)
- Non-JSON stdout: python3 parse error → inconclusive fallback (fail-open ✓)
- Helper exit nonzero: `|| LLM_TEXT=""` catches → inconclusive (fail-open ✓)
- Deep tier slot validation: UNCHANGED (still fail-closed) ✓
- Overlay fail-open `|| true`: PRESERVED in _run_overlay_llm ✓

### Remove RED marker from .test-index
Remove the line added in Task 1: `plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh: tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh [test_runner_no_direct_provider_curl_calls]`
Note: The base entry `plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh: tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh` (without RED marker) should remain if present, or be removed entirely since the fuzzy match covers it.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Zero `api.anthropic.com` references in runner
  Verify: test $(grep -c 'api\.anthropic\.com' plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh) -eq 0
- [ ] Zero `DSO_LLM_MODEL` references in runner
  Verify: test $(grep -c 'DSO_LLM_MODEL' plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh) -eq 0
- [ ] Zero hardcoded model ID strings in runner
  Verify: test $(grep -c 'claude-[a-z]' plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh) -eq 0
- [ ] `llm-api-call.sh` referenced as delegation target in runner
  Verify: grep -q 'llm-api-call.sh' plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] All tests in test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh pass
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] ShellCheck passes on runner
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] RED marker removed from .test-index
  Verify: ! grep -q '\[test_runner_no_direct_provider_curl_calls\]' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Preserve fail-open behavior on llm-api-call.sh non-zero exit for main tier (light/standard). When the runner calls llm-api-call.sh for the light or standard tier, it must append '|| LLM_TEXT=""' to capture failure without aborting: LLM_TEXT=$(bash "$(command -v llm-api-call.sh)" ...) || LLM_TEXT="". The downstream JSON parse must then produce the inconclusive fallback ({"scores":{"hygiene":"N/A",...},"findings":[],"summary":"Review inconclusive..."}) when LLM_TEXT is empty. For deep-tier specialist calls (stdout redirected to slot files), the existing fail-closed validation (slot file exists + valid JSON) is unchanged.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Reframe test_runner_extracts_json_from_markdown_fence. Markdown fence stripping is now handled inside llm-api-call.sh (the helper strips fences before returning). The runner receives already-stripped text. The existing test asserting the runner handles fenced output must be updated: either (a) drop it (coverage now in test-llm-api-call.sh) or (b) confirm the runner still parses plain JSON from the mock without error. Do not add a new fence-stripping path to the runner — that would duplicate llm-api-call.sh behavior.

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Preserve arch-synthesis inconclusive fallback explicitly. After collecting deep-tier specialist slot files, the runner validates each slot file (exists + non-empty + valid JSON). If any slot file fails validation, the arch synthesis is skipped and the runner emits an inconclusive FINDINGS_JSON (same fallback as the light/standard path). This existing behavior must be preserved unchanged when the curl calls are replaced with llm-api-call.sh redirections to slot files.
